1.text: Iki ni igitabo cy'urubyaro rwa Adamu. Ku munsi Imana yaremeyemo umuntu, afite ishusho y'Imana ni ko yamuremye,

2.text: umugabo n'umugore ni ko yabaremye, ibaha umugisha ibita Umuntu, ku munsi baremeweho.

3.text: Kandi Adamu yamaze imyaka ijana na mirongo itatu avutse, abyara umuhungu ufite ishusho ye, usa na we, amwita Seti.

4.text: Amaze kubyara Seti, Adamu arongera amara imyaka magana inani, ayibyaramo abahungu n'abakobwa.

5.text: Iminsi yose Adamu yaramye ni imyaka magana urwenda na mirongo itatu, arapfa.

6.text: Seti yamaze imyaka ijana n'itanu avutse abyara Enoshi.

7.text: Amaze kubyara Enoshi, Seti arongera amara imyaka magana inani n'irindwi, ayibyaramo abahungu n'abakobwa.

8.text: Iminsi yose Seti yaramye ni imyaka magana urwenda na cumi n'ibiri, arapfa.

9.text: Enoshi yamaze imyaka mirongo urwenda avutse abyara Kenani,

10.text: amaze kubyara Kenani, Enoshi arongera amara imyaka magana inani na cumi n'itanu, ayibyaramo abahungu n'abakobwa.

11.text: Iminsi yose Enoshi yaramye ni imyaka magana urwenda n'itanu, arapfa.

12.text: Kenani yamaze imyaka mirongo irindwi avutse abyara Mahalalēli.

13.text: Amaze kubyara Mahalalēli, Kenani arongera amara imyaka magana inani na mirongo ine, ayibyaramo abahungu n'abakobwa.

14.text: Iminsi yose Kenani yaramye ni imyaka magana urwenda na cumi, arapfa.

15.text: Mahalalēli yamaze imyaka mirongo itandatu n'itanu avutse abyara Yeredi.

16.text: Amaze kubyara Yeredi, Mahalalēli arongera amara imyaka magana inani na mirongo itatu, ayibyaramo abahungu n'abakobwa.

17.text: Iminsi yose Mahalalēli yaramye ni imyaka magana inani na mirongo urwenda n'itanu, arapfa.

18.text: Yeredi yamaze imyaka ijana na mirongo itandatu n'ibiri avutse abyara Henoki.

19.text: Amaze kubyara Henoki, Yeredi arongera amara imyaka magana inani, ayibyaramo abahungu n'abakobwa.

20.text: Iminsi yose Yeredi yaramye ni imyaka magana urwenda na mirongo itandatu n'ibiri, arapfa.

21.text: Henoki yamaze imyaka mirongo itandatu n'itanu avutse abyara Metusela.

22.text: Amaze kubyara Metusela, Henoki agendana n'Imana imyaka magana atatu, ayibyaramo abahungu n'abakobwa.

23.text: Iminsi yose Henoki yaramye ni imyaka magana atatu na mirongo itandatu n'itanu.

24.text: Kandi Henoki yagendanaga n'Imana, ntiyaboneka, kuko Imana yamwimuye.

25.text: Metusela yamaze imyaka ijana na mirongo inani n'irindwi avutse abyara Lameki.

26.text: Amaze kubyara Lameki, Metusela arongera amara imyaka magana arindwi na mirongo inani n'ibiri, ayibyaramo abahungu n'abakobwa.

27.text: Iminsi yose Metusela yaramye ni imyaka magana urwenda na mirongo itandatu n'icyenda, arapfa.

28.text: Lameki yamaze imyaka ijana na mirongo inani n'ibiri avutse, abyara umuhungu.

29.text: Amwita Nowa ati “Uyu azatumara umubabaro w'umurimo wacu n'uw'umuruho w'amaboko yacu, uva mu butaka Uwiteka yavumye.”

30.text: Amaze kubyara Nowa, Lameki arongera amara imyaka magana atanu na mirongo urwenda n'itanu, ayibyaramo abahungu n'abakobwa.

31.text: Iminsi yose Lameki yaramye ni imyaka magana arindwi na mirongo irindwi n'irindwi, arapfa.

32.text: Nowa yamaze imyaka magana atanu avutse, abyara Shemu na Hamu na Yafeti.
